title: Kim Peek's brain anatomy and his recall of 12,000 books

tellings.quote: um a lot of people thought he was autistic he he actually had hydris and so he was born with this um defect in his ability to process the cerebral spinal fluid

plain: Kim Peek, an American man famous for remembering the contents of some 12,000 books, was not autistic as many people believed, according to a researcher named Diane Powell. She says he actually had hydrocephalus, a condition he was born with in which the body cannot properly handle the fluid that surrounds the brain and spinal cord. Powell gives this as a summary, without naming a source, while discussing how unusual brains might explain unusual mental abilities.
